View Burden Statement

Certification of Consistency with Promise Zone Goals and Implementation

U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development 

OMB Number: 2501-0044
Expiration Date: 02/28/2027

I/We, the undersigned, certify under penalty of perjury that the information provided below is true, correct, and accurate. Warning: Anyone who knowingly submits a false claim or makes a false statement is subject to criminal and/or civil penalties, including confinement for up to 5 years, fines, and civil and administrative penalties (18 U.S.C §§ 287, 1001, 1010, 1012, 1014; 31 U.S.C. § 3729, 3802; 24 CFR § 28.10(b)(1)(iii)).

I/We, the undersigned, certify that the proposed activities/projects in the application are consistent with the goals of the Promise Zones and the revitalization strategies detailed in my Promise Zone application. (Complete the fields below.)

children.label: Geographic criteria
children.help_text:
Please note that projects which substantially and directly benefit Promise Zone residents but which are not within the boundaries of the Promise Zone may be considered. Agencies will make clear the acceptable definition of substantially and directly beneficial in the program’s award and funding announcement.

I further certify that:

(1) The applicant is engaged in activities, that in consultation with the Promise Zone designee, further the purposes of the Promise Zones initiative; and
(2) The applicant’s proposed activities either directly reflect the goals of the Promise Zone or will result in the delivery of services that are consistent with the goals of the Promise Zones initiative; and
(3) The applicant has committed to maintain an on-going relationship with the Promise Zone designee for the purposes of being part of the implementation processes in the designated area.

children.label: The proposed project meets the following geographic criteria (please select one):
children.help_text:
Select one option from the provided list.

Within Boundries — The proposed project is solely within Promise Zone boundaries.

Includes Zone — The proposed project includes the entire Promise Zone boundary and other communities.

Includes Portion — The proposed project includes a portion of the Promise Zone boundary.

Delivers Benefits — The proposed project is outside of the Promise Zone boundaries, but specific and definable services or benefits will be delivered within the Promise Zone or to Promise Zone residents.

notes: The exact source geographic codes, including Within Boundries, are preserved. Full choice definitions appear beside them; no geography/eligibility service is introduced.
Legal declarations and warning remain source-local text. The Promise Zone official remains a distinct role from the applicant.
Optional program number/title use their source empty-string and maximum-length bounds, not a new generic program question.
Name/organization/title reuse existing questions; signature reuses submission/signature. Optional name-part DAT min0 versus XSD min1 remains explicit.
Optional program strings preserve original XSD minLength1 when present; DAT min0 allows a broader empty lexical form. Absence remains valid.
risks: The PDF calls for a Promise Zone official, but the DAT forward-populates that official from the applicant SF-424. The definition preserves the DAT’s readonly context and names the PDF role accurately; a source owner must resolve authentic ownership before production integration.
